evals.prompt: Audit our checkout account-creation flow. Right now you can't complete a purchase without creating an account first, and we're seeing high cart abandonment.
evals.expected_output: Should check for marketing-strategy.md first. Should identify forcing account creation before purchase as a likely major friction point and recommend guest checkout as the default, with account creation offered post-purchase instead. Should walk through minimizing required fields and reference the Ecommerce Checkout Account pattern.
assertions: Identifies forced pre-purchase account creation as a friction point
Recommends guest checkout as the default
Recommends offering account creation post-purchase instead of gating checkout

evals.prompt: Should we auto-enroll customers in our loyalty program at checkout, or make it opt-in?
evals.expected_output: Should walk through the tradeoff (auto-enroll/opt-out likely lifts enrollment numbers vs. explicit opt-in). Should flag that if loyalty enrollment includes marketing messages (email/SMS), auto-enroll has real consent implications and route to compliance before recommending it, rather than treating it as a pure conversion-rate question.
assertions: Presents the auto-enroll vs opt-in tradeoff
Flags marketing-consent implications if enrollment includes marketing messages
Routes to compliance rather than treating this as a pure CRO question

evals.prompt: We're setting up a B2B/wholesale account application form for independent retailers. What should it look like?
evals.expected_output: Should reference the B2B/Wholesale Account Application pattern: business details (name, tax/resale ID if required, business type), contact + intended order volume, and note this typically needs manual review/approval rather than instant activation. Should reference marketing-strategy Section 16 and paywalls for the trade-pricing reveal once approved.
assertions: References the B2B/wholesale account application pattern with business-verification fields
Notes manual review/approval rather than instant activation
References paywalls for the trade-pricing reveal

evals.prompt: What experiments should we run to improve our loyalty program signup rate?
evals.expected_output: Should draw from the Account-Creation Commitment Experiments and Copy & Messaging Experiments sections: testing a signup incentive vs. none, auto-enroll vs. opt-in (with the compliance caveat), field minimization, CTA copy testing the real incentive, and trust elements. Should not reference free trials, freemium, or SaaS-specific concepts.
assertions: Draws experiment ideas from the retail-relevant experiment sections
Does not reference free trials, freemium, or SaaS-specific concepts
